basics.name: Jack Stehn
basics.label: Data & Analytics Engineer
basics.summary: Data & Analytics Engineer who builds the pipelines, warehouses, and models that turn messy, multi-system data into numbers people trust. I've designed modern data stacks (Dagster, dbt, dlt, BigQuery) end to end, from ingestion and data quality checks to the semantic layers and dashboards stakeholders use every day. I bring a software engineering mindset—CI/CD, testing, and modular design—so data systems stay maintainable, observable, and useful.

work.name: Innovare
highlights: **Pipeline Reliability:** Own the stability and scalability of production data pipelines feeding high-stakes EdTech dashboards, ensuring datasets remain accurate and auditable for enterprise school district customers.

**Medallion Architecture Design:** Co-designing a transition to a Medallion (bronze/silver/gold) data architecture on BigQuery, defining layer contracts, freshness SLAs, and lineage to improve traceability and downstream analytics velocity.

**Modern Stack Advocacy:** Proposed adopting Terraform (IaC), dlt (ingestion), dbt (transformation), Dagster (orchestration), Cube.js (semantic layer) to replace ad-hoc workflows — enabling version control, automated testing, and unified observability across the platform.
**Workflow Automation:** Replacing manual customer delivery workflows with automated, idempotent pipelines, reducing turnaround time and eliminating recurring sources of data drift between systems.

**Cross-System Integration:** Manage complex data flows across disparate EdTech sources, designing for schema evolution, late-arriving data, and the operational realities of multi-tenant customer delivery.

work.name: Caliber Public Schools
work.position: Data Scientist (Lead: Data Engineering, MLOps) - Ed Pioneers Fellow
highlights: **Modern Data Stack Architecture:** Architected and built a scalable platform on GCP. Orchestrated ELT pipelines using Dagster, dbt, and dlt to ingest data from disparate SIS (School Information Systems) and HR platforms into BigQuery.

**Engineering Maturity (ROI):** Engineered a comprehensive People Team data pipeline, reducing manual consistency checks from months of collective annual work to seconds. Built a custom automated data quality framework to catch inconsistencies between systems.

**API Integration & Interoperability:** Solved complex data interoperability challenges by designing integrations between Schoolmint and PowerSchool. Reverse-engineered undocumented APIs to create a unified data model for cross-functional analysis.

**Solo Data Lead:** Owned the full data lifecycle as the sole data professional, partnering directly with C-suite and department heads to move the org from manual spreadsheets to automated warehousing.

**Data Democratization:** Updated the organization's data security policy and designed data literacy training modules, empowering school leaders to access real-time metrics without technical bottlenecks.

work.name: SetSail
highlights: **Pipeline Architecture (AWS):** Led a critical overhaul of the AWS data infrastructure (S3, Athena, EMR). Implemented 'SQL Push-down' strategies and asynchronous DAGs, reducing data processing latency by 75% and scaling to multi-terabyte datasets.
**Scalable Data Modeling:** Architected scalable Star Schema data models and optimized ETL/ELT processes, ensuring data readiness for ML and LLM integration.
**Engineering Best Practices:** Championed the adoption of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), unit testing (pytest), and Agile methodologies within the data science team.
**Business Impact:** Contributed to infrastructure enhancements that achieved 33% faster ramp times, 16% higher revenue, and 15x ROI for customers.
**Cross-Functional Leadership:** Collaborated with Engineering, Product, and Support teams to spec out large-scale infrastructure restructuring.
